name: L10 PanoLab pixel-unseen geospatial open-set negative panel
question: Can a positive-calibrated dual score-and-margin gate reject four newly selected entrance-ray views whose cameras are at least 1.5 km from every positive-roster entrance, without observing their pixels before source and thresholds are frozen?

selection.exclude_prior_target_ways: Exclude every target way in the prior active-ray, fresh four-target, reference-portal, and node-credential sources.
selection.exclude_prior_items: Exclude every item in those sources plus both Le Viviani reference items.
selection.within_target: Choose the eligible strict-orientation DIRECT item nearest 30 metres, tie by item ID.
selection.panel: Sort eligible targets within source city by target-way ID and item ID, then select round-robin over sorted city names while requiring unique target ways, items, collections, and at least three cities.
forbidden_inputs: selected full, SD, thumbnail, tile, or derived pixels
OCR, CLIP, DINOv2, or any learned-model output on selected images
selected-image top-1 score, margin, or open-set decision

open_set_contract.calibration_source: The four source-extended positive episodes in l10_panolab_component_router_result_v1.json; all were consumed Development before this negative source was selected.
open_set_contract.threshold_rule: Set each threshold to the minimum corresponding value across the four correct positive-roster queries, with no negative examples and no search over alternative statistics.
open_set_contract.accept: Emit APPEARANCE_SEARCH_PRIORITY_CANDIDATE only if both the top-1 facade-fingerprint score and top-1-minus-runner-up margin meet their frozen minima; otherwise UNKNOWN_KEEP_SEARCHING.
open_set_contract.semantics: This is a tiny positive-calibrated selective Development rule. It is not conformal calibration, does not control FDR, and has no distribution-shift guarantee.

materialization.provider: Panoramax OpenStreetMap France HD image asset recorded in each frozen provider item
materialization.partial_download_policy: Download to item-specific .jpg.part files, atomically replace finals, and remove task-owned partials in a finally path.
materialization.overwrite: Refuse an existing selection, manifest, or output root.

research_basis.title: SafeVPR: Patch-Based Conformal Verification for Safe Cross-Condition Sequence Visual Place Recognition
research_basis.use: Motivates separating retrieval from patch-based verification and abstention. This four-positive calibration does not implement its sequence verifier or conformal Learn-Then-Test guarantees.

research_basis.title: Through the Lens of Doubt: Robust and Efficient Uncertainty Estimation for Visual Place Recognition
research_basis.use: Motivates using score separation as a training-free ambiguity signal. This protocol freezes only raw top-1 score and margin and makes no benchmark-comparability claim.

claim_boundary.allowed: A pixel-unseen selection and materialization receipt for four new geospatially excluded Panoramax entrance-ray controls, with the selective score/margin contract frozen before their pixels are downloaded.
not_allowed: target absence before the post-download human truth review is frozen
formal open-set, conformal, FDR, calibration, or distribution-shift guarantees
portal ownership, access, traversability, waypoint, arrival, user benefit, deployment performance, or safety
